authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 5103 jani explicitly gives Prakrit jaṇī and Hindi/Maithili janī “woman, wife”. The survey jani/janni forms retain that meaning and compatible consonant skeleton; regional transmission remains open. Joint comparison: bundeli_atarra janni “woman” matches reviewed Dang dʒʌnːi “woman” (f_warru54mbat6u). The shared family is provisionally linked under the user’s preference; inheritance versus intra-IA borrowing is not resolved by this formal comparison.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9361.2 bhagna explicitly derives run/flee stems through Prakrit bhagga “broken, fled”, with Hindi bhāgnā and Old Marwari bhāgaï “runs”. The article retains the debated relation between breaking and fleeing; this selects the g-stem branch. Joint comparison: bundeli_atarra bʰago “run!” matches reviewed had bʰāgɔ “run!” (f_pto5girvq6skg). The shared family is provisionally linked under the user’s preference; inheritance versus intra-IA borrowing is not resolved by this formal comparison.
